Read snapshot pins WAL; monitor disk capacity/time, no claim of eliminating resource pressure.
METADATA_SOURCE remains outside snapshot supervisor; synchronous integrity stage is not fixed by this change.
Hardlink deadline check and publication have a small unavoidable scheduling race.
Synthetic tmpfs/host tests do not prove production I/O behavior or root cause of previous stall.
